facts.business: Repono Limited is one of India's leading third-party logistics (3PL) companies specialising in integrated storage, handling and supply chain solutions for the energy, petrochemical and industrial sectors.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital expenditure on fixed assets, including capital advances

auditor.name: V S BAPNA & ASSOCIATES
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matter: The Company has written off certain export receivables during the year for INR 1.17 crores. This amount represents outstanding dues relating to export services rendered in the previous financial period. We identified this transaction as a key audit matter due to management's self assessment regarding non recoverability of export receivables and regulatory risks.

key_risks: Non-recoverability of export receivables and regulatory risks
